notes: Exact run HEAD and logs were independently read via connected GitHub jobs; checked-in evidence is structural, not signed workflow attestation.
LLVM original 57 blob source subset is not the complete production compiler repository.
Calling a SHA-256-pinned compiler binary is only integrity comparison unless compiler provenance is established separately; the linked CI does exactly that.
The 9 canonical frontend refusal controls apply to the restricted M4 actor syntax and are not proof of all AttoLang ownership features.
Graally native host-worker message send operations are independently threaded and bounded but are not generated by canonical .atto codegen.
GraalVM Native Image Epsilon zero observed runtime collections does not mean zero managed allocations; 25,690,112 bytes grew over 100,000 admitted messages, exceeding 8MiB qualification target.
One OS worker thread per actor is an experimental profile and not a production scalable carrier scheduler.
Native Image build-time GC counts must never be represented as guest-runtime GC collections.
